lib_size %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%

    mean_expression = mean(Gene_expression),

  )

levels(dds$group)

dds <- dds[keep, ]
nrow(dds)

#3a
dds <- DESeq(dds)
write.csv(counts(dds, normalized = TRUE), "results/normalized_counts.csv", qu
          ote = FALSE)
#3b
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("group", "trt", "untrt"))
head(res)
res <- res[order(res$padj), ]
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$gene <- rownames(res_df)
res_df$status <- "Not significant"
res_df$status[res_df$padj < 0.05 & res_df$log2FoldChange >= 1] <- "Up"
res_df$status[res_df$padj < 0.05 & res_df$log2FoldChange <= -1] <- "Down"
table(res_df$status)
#3c

write.csv(degs, paste0("results/", comparison, "_DEGs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
deg_table <- read.csv(paste0("results/", comparison, "_DEGs.csv"))
head(deg_table, 5)
#3d
# 1. We give DESeq2 raw counts and not normalised counts because it can estimate size factor and dispersion internally to fit a negative binomial model
# 2. Some genes have padj = NA because gene with low counts are left out
# 3. A gene has log2FC = 3, it means that the treated count is 2 ^3 times more than untreated count
# 4a
volcano_data <- res_df[!is.na(res_df$padj), ] # remove genes with padj = N
A
p_volcano <- ggplot(volcano_data,
                    aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "firebrick",
                                "Down" = "steelblue",
                                "Not significant" = "grey70")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = trt_vs_untrt,
       x = "log2 fold change",
       y = "-log10 adjusted p-value") +
  theme_bw()
p_volcano
ggsave(paste0("plots/volcano_", comparison, ".png"), p_volcano,
       width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
